 Sarah Paulson Closes Her ‘All’s Fair’ Press Tour with Four Looks
 Posted by Catherine Kallon 
 Sarah Paulson has had an incredibly busy few weeks promoting All’s Fair , and following the final premiere in New York, the actress spent the rest of the week making the rounds on the city’s talk shows and attending press engagements.
  XNY/Star Max/GC Images 
 Out in New York
 Despite the trousers being so long that she is practically standing on them, I have to say that I really like this off-duty look. Mostly because it feels so intrinsically Sarah, and this is exactly how I would imagine her dressing when she’s not on the red carpet. I just wish someone had taken a few inches off those hems. Jessica McCormack jewelry completed her look.
 Raymond Hall/GC Images 
 Good Morning America
 I love Sarah’s appreciation for a detailed skirt, and this Michael Kors Spring 2027 look is another example of why. The green-and-black striped rugby shirt gives the embellished floral skirt a preppy twist, and I like the contrast between the two. The grey pointed pumps wouldn’t have been my first choice, but they don’t take anything away from my appreciation of this look. Jessica McCormack jewelry completed her look.
 Michael Kors Spring 2027 
 Courtesy of Givenchy 
 Live with Kelly and Mark
 Judging by her Roksanda look at the All’s Fair premiere, the first look above and this Givenchy Spring 2027 suit, Sarah was clearly in the mood for exaggerated silhouettes this week.
 At first glance, this appears to be a classic black satin suit, but the reversed lapels give the jacket an unexpected twist. I love how the polka-dot tie also adds character to the black satin suit, making the tailoring feel less formal.
 TheStewartofNY/GC Images 
 Press Junket
 Sarah’s final look of the week came from the Miu Miu Spring 2027 collection. Although this is technically a spring look, the leather and darker colour palette make it feel more appropriate for autumn. I don’t know why, but there’s something about this look – perhaps it’s the combination of the navy knit and sensible skirt length – that makes her look like an undercover detective.
 Styled by Karla Welch.
